GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 602 (17 Nov 48) CPC/FP
(SCAPIN-1965/1)
APO 500
8 March 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Property in Japan of Companies with Head Offices Abroad.
1. Reference is made to the following memoranda for the Japanese Government from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers:
a. File AG 130 (22 Sep 45) ESS, SCAPIN 45, 22 September 1945, subject, “Control of Financial Transactions.”
b. File AG 602 (17 Nov 48) CPC/FP, SCAPIN 1965, 18 January 1949, subject, “Liquidation of Property in Japan of Branches of Companies with Head Offices Outside Japan.”
2. For purposes of reference 1b, property in Japan of companies with head offices in areas of former Japanese occupation will include all property located in Japan owned or claimed by the head office abroad together with, but not by way of limitation to, securities registered in Japan in the name of the head office; title deeds and mortgages to property in Japan owned by the head office; bank pass books, receipts, checks, drafts, promissory notes; bills of exchange, certificates of title and indebtedness and all other written evidence of title or interest in property in Japan owned by the head office.
3. Companies referred to herein and in reference 1b above are exclusive of those in process of liquidation under Ordinance No.74 (Closed Institutions Ordinance).
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
